description: This file defines a Java interface named 'Option' which acts as a common contract for all options applicable to a search query within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for accepting visitors and converting the option to its string representation.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Interface for all options which can be applied to a search query in the Ditto model.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing OptionVisitor, following the Visitor pattern, and calls its visit method with this option.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the option, formatted according to implementation-specific rules.
